title: Spectral Non-Dispersal, the Ring Lemma, and a Conditional Regularity Framework for the Navier–Stokes Equations on T³
desc:
We develop a conditional regularity framework for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations on the periodic torus T³ with H¹ initial data. The framework is organized around two new results: the Spectral Non-Dispersal condition [SND] and the Ring Lemma.
